title: CrossGMN: Graph Metanetworks for Cross-Architecture Weight-Space Transformations
abstract: arXiv:2610.01649v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight-space networks operate directly on parameters of other neural networks, enabling tasks such as predicting model properties, editing trained models, and generating weights. Weight-space symmetries such as neuron permutations make equivariance a key design principle. However, existing equivariant weight-space architectures have primarily been studied for transformations that preserve the network architecture. In contrast, many practical transformations, including model compression and upscaling, map a trained source network into a target network with a different architecture. In this setting, the source and target permutation symmetries act on different parameter spaces, making equivariance less straightforward to formulate. Our key idea for addressing this mismatch is to reformulate cross-architecture operators with two inputs: a trained source network and an initialization of the target network. translated_title: CrossGMN：用于跨架构权重空间变换的图元网络
translated_abstract: 权重空间网络直接作用于其他神经网络的参数，能够完成诸如预测模型属性、编辑已训练模型和生成权重等任务。诸如神经元置换之类的权重空间对称性使得等变性成为关键的设计原则。然而，现有的等变权重空间架构主要针对保持网络架构不变的变换进行研究。相比之下，许多实际应用中的变换，包括模型压缩和升规模，会将一个已训练的源网络映射到一个具有不同架构的目标网络。在这种设定下，源网络和目标网络的置换对称性作用于不同的参数空间，使得等变性的表述变得不那么直接。我们解决这一不匹配问题的关键思路是将跨架构算子重新表述为具有两个输入的算子：一个已训练的源网络和一个目标网络的初始化。这使我们能够定义等变的跨架构算子（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出CrossGMN，通过将跨架构变换重新表述为“已训练源网络+目标网络初始化”的双输入形式，构建等变的图元网络，从而在源与目标架构不同（如模型压缩和升规模）的情况下实现等变的权重空间变换。
en_tdlr: CrossGMN introduces graph metanetworks that achieve equivariant cross-architecture weight-space transformations (e.g., model compression and upscaling) by reformulating cross-architecture operators as functions of two inputs: a trained source network and an initialization of the target network.
